system.description: When you **_first meet someone from beyond Stonetop_**, roll +Fortunes: **on a 10+**, say what they’ve heard about you or Stonetop, and gain advantage on your next move against them; **on a 7-9**, say what they’ve heard; **on a 6-**, the GM decides what they’ve heard.

success.value: Say what they’ve heard about you or Stonetop, and gain advantage on your next move against them.

failure.value: The GM decides what they’ve heard.
